summary: Regression re-test of the one-line domain fix in _fetch_ufc (server.py): switched ESPN URL from site.api.espn.com (Akamai-blocked, 403) to site.web.api.espn.com to match _fetch_score/_fetch_streak. Confirmed fix works: ESPN endpoint now returns 200 and the real-data ok:1 path is reachable. Re-ran all 6 existing tests in test_matrix_feed_ufc.py - all pass, no regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix confirmed correct: _fetch_ufc now uses https://site.web.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/mma/ufc/scoreboard, matching the working pattern in _fetch_score/_fetch_streak. Direct curl to that URL from this sandbox returns HTTP 200 (previously the old site.api.espn.com endpoint returned 403).

Manual GET /api/matrix/feed?lat=35.5563&lon=-80.8714&radius=40&severity=severe&flights=0&sports=0&weather=0&ufc=1 returned ufc: {ok:1, name:'UFC Fight Night', date:'Sat Sep 26', headline:'Vanessa Demopoulos vs Yazmin Jauregui'} - all fields are sane, non-garbage strings. Note: the date reflects the most recent event in ESPN's scoreboard response at query time (fallback to events[0] when no non-'post' state event exists); this is expected behavior per the existing selection logic, not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The _fetch_ufc ESPN domain fix (site.api.espn.com -> site.web.api.espn.com) is verified working. ok:1 real-data path is now reachable from this sandbox and returns sane data. All 6 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_matrix_feed_ufc.py pass (6/6). No further action needed for this specific fix.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this iteration was a verification of an already-applied fix, not a new RCA. Original RCA: site.api.espn.com is Akamai-blocked for datacenter/sandbox IPs (403), while site.web.api.espn.com serves the same scoreboard data without that block.
